title: Vehicle Emergency Kit
description: Lists a core kit for breakdowns, signaling, first aid, food, warmth, and navigation, plus winter and summer additions and the half-tank rule. Covers jump starters vs. cables, plugging or changing a tire, evacuation prep, staying with a stranded car, signaling for help, and kids and pets.
shortDescription: Core car kit, tire repair, seasonal additions, and what to do if stranded
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
